ACTION=A2
Rationale: A pedestrian is actively crossing the ego vehicle's path at a forward distance of 28.6 meters. Given the ego vehicle's initial speed of 30 kph (approx. 8.33 m/s), the time to reach the conflict point is approximately 3.4 seconds. The pedestrian, moving at 2.0 m/s from a lateral position of -4.0 m, will be in the immediate path of the ego vehicle within this timeframe. Therefore, the ego vehicle must decelerate (A2) to ensure a safe stopping distance and avoid a collision.
